title: Apple Pass Designer
why_read: A niche but genuinely technical look at Apple's tool for designing Wallet passes, interesting to iOS/Wallet developers and anyone curious about little-known Apple developer tooling.
analysis: Apple Pass Designer is apparently a lesser-known internal or developer-facing tool for creating Apple Wallet passes, the kind of thing most iOS developers encounter only when building ticketing or loyalty-card features. The discussion volume suggests people are sharing tips, reverse-engineered details, or surprise at its existence/behavior. It's a fairly narrow topic but genuinely technical and could save real time for anyone who has struggled with Wallet pass JSON schemas and signing certificates.
